item.title: How is public-private-civic collaboration transforming government?
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how collaboration between public, private, and civic sectors is reshaping government operations and services. The collection seeks to understand the mechanisms and impacts of cross-sector partnerships in the context of government modernization and technological innovation.
